title: Reconnect and resync without world reset
description: When a player's connection drops (network blip, tab sleep), the ship keeps living in the shard; on reconnect the player resumes seamlessly with a full resync and no world reset, no duplicate entities.
acceptanceCriteria: Disconnect: connection removed from shard, presence_leave broadcast; ship remains simulated (idle) for as long as the shard lives (TASK-12 grace/reap rules unchanged)

Reconnect: same token, join_system to the same system → receives full snapshot containing their own ship at its current (possibly moved-while-idle) position; prediction state rebuilt (TASK-14 rewind path handles the gap)
No duplicates: reconnecting never creates a second ship entity for the player (ship is keyed by playerId in the sim — test asserts entity count unchanged after reconnect)
Reconnect within 60 s of drop: client shows 'Reconnected' toast, no full UI reset (chat log and player list preserved if the system is unchanged)
Long absence: if the shard reaped while away (no one else in the system), the player re-joins the reloaded shard and finds their ship exactly where the last flush put it (TASK-24)
WS integration tests: drop (close socket mid-flight), reconnect, position continuity < 1 u from where inputs stopped; duplicate-entity assertion; reap-and-rejoin test with fake timers

steps.details: Already implied by TASK-12 (ships persist after leave). Add: on leave, the sim marks the ship 'idle' (no inputs accepted from that conn) — inputs from a stale connId are dropped with a debug log.

Client: on ws 'open' after a close (client auto-retry with 1 s backoff up to 30 s, then show a 'Connection lost' overlay with Retry button), re-run auth + join_system. On snapshot: reset PredictionEngine and RemoteBuffers, rebuild presence; keep UI state (chat, list) if same systemId.
Integration tests per acceptance: mid-flight drop (send inputs, close, wait 2 s, reconnect, compare position), entity-count invariant, reap-rejoin. Run full suite.

technicalNotes: Auto-retry lives in the client ws wrapper (src/client/net/socket.ts) with exponential backoff capped at 5 s.
The 'Connection lost' overlay is the only full-screen UI in v1; it must not block the ESC menu.
